faq_lists.title: What services do Bits Collision provide?
faq_lists.content: We provide software, mobile app, web, e-commerce, UI/UX, cloud, digital marketing, AI, and branding solutions.

faq_lists.title: Which industries do you work with?
faq_lists.content: We work with businesses across technology, finance, e-commerce, healthcare, real estate, and other industries.

faq_lists.title: How do I start a project with Bits Collision?
faq_lists.content: Contact us with your requirements. We’ll discuss your goals and guide you through the next steps.

faq_lists.title: How long does a project take?
faq_lists.content: Timelines depend on the project scope, features, complexity, and technology requirements.

faq_lists.title: Do you provide support after launch?
faq_lists.content: Yes. We provide ongoing maintenance, technical support, updates, and optimization.

faq_lists.title: Can you help with digital marketing?
faq_lists.content: Yes. We offer SEO, SEM, social media marketing, AI-powered advertising, and digital marketing strategies.

faq_lists.title: Do you build e-commerce websites?
faq_lists.content: Yes. We create customized e-commerce solutions based on your business requirements.
